method: hand check of release 1.8.0 after the developer's response (iliasbeshimov/zoteroplugins.org#18); rules of requirements-check-1

apiKey.keyFor: your own sign-in to an assistant: Claude Code (the default), Codex, Antigravity or an ACP agent. No API key is entered for these; only the Custom API backend takes an optional key

checkNote: Default backend is the Claude Code CLI (prefs.js), run on the user's own sign-in with API keys removed from its environment (binaries.js), so the default setup needs a sign-in of the user's own: "required" under the rule (a key, token, password or sign-in). Not an API key. Codex, Antigravity and ACP agents work the same way; the Custom API (OpenAI-compatible) backend offers "No authentication" or an API key. Ollama and Unsloth backends on 127.0.0.1 run a local model. The 2026-09-30 check (README only) had localModel unknown.
